transcript:
Customer: Hi, I'd like to make a reservation for tomorrow evening.
    Agent: Certainly! How many people will be dining?
    Customer: There will be 4 of us.
    Agent: And what time would you prefer?
    Customer: Around 7 PM would be great.
    Agent: Perfect. And may I have your name for the reservation?
    Customer: It's John Smith.
    Agent: Great! I have a reservation for John Smith, party of 4, tomorrow at 7 PM. 
    Any special occasions or dietary restrictions I should note?
    Customer: It's actually my wife's birthday, and one of our guests is vegetarian.
    Agent: Wonderful! I'll note the birthday celebration and ensure vegetarian options are available.
    Your reservation is confirmed!
